outcome: Preterm birth (extremely preterm, very preterm, moderate or late preterm)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 52,544 pregnant women aged 45 years or older (very advanced maternal age) from the National Vital Statistics System database.
finding: Very advanced maternal age (vAMA) women with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) had an increased risk of preterm birth (especially moderate or late preterm birth) and NICU admission, but a significantly lower risk of low birthweight.
